name: sf-route-work
title: Route Salesforce Work
description: Route Salesforce development, administration, architecture or incident work. Also use for reviewing changes, preparing validation, drafting Jira updates, saving handovers and resuming project work.

name: sf-investigate-issue
title: Investigate Salesforce Issues
description: Trace Salesforce errors, incorrect data, unexpected automation, debug logs and integration failures to evidence. Use for root-cause investigation before implementing a fix.

name: sf-design-architecture
title: Design Salesforce Architecture
description: Plan new Salesforce development or enhancements, review architecture and evaluate reuse. Inspect current systems, produce a versioned architecture plan with acceptance criteria, and obtain approval before implementation.

name: sf-build-apex
title: Build and Review Apex
description: Implement and review Apex classes, triggers, Batch, Queueable, Finalizer, invocable and REST services. Use for .cls and .trigger changes after scope or root cause is established.

name: sf-review-automation
title: Review and Build Automation
description: Investigate, design or change Salesforce Flow, validation rules, approval dependencies and trigger interactions. Use for automation conflicts, expiration overwrites, recursion and Flow metadata.

name: sf-test-behavior
title: Test Salesforce Behavior
description: Create and assess Apex, LWC, Flow, integration and user acceptance tests. Use for test failures, coverage improvement and regression design without weakening business assertions.

name: sf-review-access
title: Review Salesforce Access
description: Review CRUD/FLS, sharing, Experience Cloud access, integration principals, credentials and Apex API version changes. Use for security-sensitive Salesforce design and code reviews.

name: sf-review-portal
title: Review Experience Cloud Portals
description: Build and investigate Experience Cloud LWC, distributor visibility, assets, entitlements and Salesforce Files. Use for portal search and certificate access or download failures.

name: sf-engineer-cpq
title: Engineer CPQ and Revenue Workflows
description: Investigate or implement Salesforce CPQ quoting, pricing, cloning, approvals, orders and document generation. Use for SBQQ managed package workflows and quote reissue; distinguish Revenue Cloud first.

name: sf-integrate-reliably
title: Build Reliable Salesforce Integrations
description: Design and diagnose Salesforce REST/SOAP, Platform Events, CDC, Pub/Sub and MuleSoft connections. Use for intermittent delivery, timeout, replay, duplicate and recovery problems.

name: sf-audit-org
title: Audit Salesforce Orgs
description: Inventory and compare Salesforce metadata, package versions, permissions and environment drift. Use for sandbox versus production analysis or a scoped org assessment.

name: sf-release-change
title: Release Salesforce Changes
description: Plan, validate and release Salesforce metadata and controlled data changes. Use for deployment failures, release sequencing, production rollout and rollback planning.

name: sf-manage-data
title: Manage Salesforce Data
description: Plan SOQL, data migration, deduplication and controlled bulk changes. Use for data repair, import/export, reconciliation and query design.

name: sf-operate-sales-service
title: Operate Sales and Service Cloud
description: Investigate Sales Cloud and Service Cloud behavior including leads, opportunities, cases, routing, entitlements, milestones and work orders.

name: sf-operate-marketing
title: Operate Marketing Cloud
description: Investigate or design Marketing Cloud Engagement and Account Engagement integrations, journeys and audience operations. Use for SFMC REST/SOAP, data extensions, subscriber keys and marketing automation.

name: sf-operate-data-analytics
title: Operate Data and Analytics
description: Review Data 360/Data Cloud ingestion, identity resolution, activation, CRM Analytics, reports and Tableau integration. Use for data lineage, incorrect aggregates and analytics access.

name: sf-evaluate-agentforce
title: Evaluate Agentforce
description: Design or test Agentforce actions, grounded responses, permissions, handoffs and evaluation suites. Use for agent quality, prompt injection, unsafe actions and regression testing.

name: sf-route-specialist-clouds
title: Route Specialist Salesforce Clouds
description: Research and route Salesforce Industries, OmniStudio, Field Service, Commerce, Health, Financial Services, Education, Nonprofit, Life Sciences, Consumer Goods and other specialist products.

name: sf-package-solution
title: Package Salesforce Solutions
description: Plan Salesforce unlocked or managed packaging, namespace boundaries, dependencies, upgrades and AppExchange preparation. Use for reusable package delivery and multi-org distribution.

name: sf-project-context
title: Apply Salesforce Project Context
description: Apply project-specific Salesforce context from approved local records. Use when business acceptance criteria, integration contracts or historical decisions affect a task; verify them against current evidence.
